title: 고등교육기관의 자체평가에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Disclosure of Evaluation Results)
The head of a school shall disclose the results of its self-evaluation through the website of the relevant institution or by other means.
